messages:
maria: FYI: platform wants to standardize routing headers. Plan to replace `X-Rd-Route` with a stable, versioned `Rd-Route-V2`. Need SDK owners + console/telemetry to coordinate rollout and attribution.
aj: Is this a breaking change for customers? What's the compatibility plan?
chris: Server will accept both for a transition period, but console needs to surface both values until clients upgrade to avoid quota spikes. We'll add telemetry keys: `route_header_version` and `route_header_source`.
sasha: I'll prep migration docs and code examples for Python/TS/Go. My proposal: opt-in flag in SDKs, one minor release with warning logs, then remove legacy in a later major/minor after the window.
leo: devex-bot: canary py-sdk run showed flaky header parser when header missing (py#432). Filing follow-up tests.
aj: I'll add tolerant parsing and a deprecation logger helper in Go/TS. For Go: `ParseRouteHeader(h string) (version string, source string)` for consistency.
maria: Draft timeline: announce week 0, opt-in patch with warnings week 1, telemetry sampling + console tile week 3, server fallback dry-run week 6, hard remove week 12. Adjust if any owners can't meet.
chris: Console work: add per-tenant % legacy-vs-v2 metric, a time-series of quota deltas, and a migration pane linking SDK guides. Backfill job to reconcile past attribution will run after tiles are in place.
sasha: I'll open PRs for py/ts today, Go by Friday. Will include snippet:
```
# python
client = Redwood(api_key=KEY, route_header_mode="v2_optin")
```
aj: ACK. Will ship parsing helper + opt-in patch next week. Will include deprecation messages that surface in logs and telemetry events so customers see migration nudges.
maria: Please ack here with ETA. If any team needs a longer grace period, call it out now so platform extends server fallback.
chris: Ack — console tile ETA 2 weeks, backfill job ETA 3 weeks.
sasha: Ack — py/ts PRs today, go PR Friday.
aj: Ack — parsing helper + tests next week.
leo: I'll re-run canaries after PRs and report results. devex-bot: reminder set for 5 days to check PRs + canary status.
